description: This file defines a utility object CalendarUtils that provides functions for generating calendar days for a specified month, checking if two dates are on the same day, verifying if a date is today, and converting dates to start or end of day times. It is used for calendar and date-related operations within an Android or Kotlin project.

classes.name: CalendarUtils
classes.description: An object containing utility functions for calendar and date operations.

methods.name: getMonthDays
methods.description: Generates a list of Date objects representing the days to display for a specific month, including days from previous and next months to fill the calendar grid.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Checks whether two Date objects fall on the same calendar day.

methods.name: isToday
methods.description: Checks whether the provided date is the current day.

methods.name: toStartOfDay
methods.description: Converts a Date object to the start of that day (00:00:00.000).

methods.name: toEndOfDay
methods.description: Converts a Date object to the end of that day (23:59:59.999).
